meta.title: Nauxica | Hospitality, connected.
meta.description: Nauxica, Hospitality, connected. Premium hospitality management for owners, guests, operations and local partners.

hero.lead: One intelligent platform connecting guests, owners, operations and local partners.
hero.guestCommDesc: Centralised messaging and support across the guest journey.
hero.checkinDesc: Arrival information, access details and welcome instructions.
hero.opsDesc: Cleaning, maintenance and service requests in one flow.
hero.ownerVisDesc: Clear reporting, performance insights and operational overview.

problem.h2:
Too much to manage.
Not enough visibility.
problem.intro: Guest communication, operations and owner reporting are often spread across too many tools, slowing teams down and creating unnecessary friction.
problem.fragmentedDesc: Messages are scattered across WhatsApp, email and booking platforms.
problem.manualDesc: Cleaning, maintenance and service requests require constant follow up.
problem.limitedDesc: Performance, guest sentiment and partner activity are hard to track clearly.

solution.h2: One connected flow for modern hospitality.
solution.intro: Nauxica brings guest support, operations, local partners and owner visibility into one intelligent hospitality rhythm.
solution.conciergeDesc: Guests can ask for check in details, house rules, recommendations, transfers and support through natural messaging.
solution.opsDesc: Cleaning, maintenance, service requests and local partner workflows are managed in one connected operational flow.
solution.intelligenceDesc: Owners get a clear view of occupancy, revenue, guest satisfaction, requests and partner activity at a glance.

how.h2: From property setup to connected operations.
how.intro: Nauxica turns scattered hospitality tasks into one clear operating flow, from guest arrival to partner coordination and owner reporting.
how.step1Desc: Add property details, house rules, check in instructions and preferred services.
how.step2Desc: The platform supports guest messaging, service requests, recommendations and partner workflows.
how.step3Desc: Owners see performance, requests, tasks, revenue signals and partner activity in one view.

dashboard.h2: A clear view of the whole operation.
dashboard.lead: Occupancy, revenue, guest satisfaction, messages and partner activity at a glance.

services.lead: Tools that help owners, operators and local partners deliver exceptional guest experiences.
services.checkinDesc: Arrival details, access codes and welcome instructions.
services.cleaningDesc: Turnover tasks linked to arrivals and departures.
services.maintenanceDesc: Capture issues and coordinate action quickly.
services.upsellDesc: Transfers, tours, restaurants and added services.
services.reportingDesc: Performance, requests and guest satisfaction in one view.

guestExp.lead: A seamless digital guest journey that helps visitors feel supported from check-in to local recommendations, using simple and natural messaging.

marketplace.h2: A trusted local network around every property.
marketplace.lead: Cleaning companies, transfer teams, restaurants, bars, tour providers, maintenance specialists and local experiences can receive requests, accept or reject tasks, update availability and track earnings.
marketplace.caption1: Turnovers and quality checks managed with clarity.
marketplace.caption2: Airport transfers coordinated through trusted local partners.

pricing.h2: Simple plans for connected hospitality operations.
pricing.lead: Choose the plan that matches your portfolio size. Every plan is designed to help you centralise guest communication, owner visibility, operations and local partner services.
pricing.essentialF2: Property profile and house rules setup

cta.h2: Build a more connected hospitality experience.
cta.lead: Start with a demo and explore how Nauxica could support your properties, guests and local partner ecosystem.
